calls.video_title: This ‘Always’ Happens to Stocks in a Midterm Year (It’s Happening Again Now)
calls.thesis: Guest Mark Chaikin: BUY reiterated (his last MarketBeat call was BUY on 2026-09-30; no same-voice flip — the channel's interim HOLD on 2026-10-03 was host Bridget, a different speaker). Palantir is a disruptor in defence/government and enterprise data processing, pulled back after a recent new high and stabilising; 'a stock you want to own for the next 6 to 12 months' and 'a great buying opportunity here' into the midterm sweet spot.
calls.base_case: Midterm low has been seen (100 years / 24 midterms: market bottoms mid-October, median +22% to the following summer peak); pullbacks of 1-3 days are the entry, and he expects a new high within about a month.
calls.bull_case: Expects a blowout quarter on Mon 2 Nov earnings; commercial sales growing substantially alongside government, and contracts already baked in are hard to replace once embedded.

calls.thesis: US commercial revenue +149% and $2.1B TCV (+271%) with 93% revenue growth and 63% FCF margin; but updated DCF gives FV $184 vs ~$189 market — fairly valued, so conviction lowered from high to medium. No flip in direction.
calls.base_case: Great business at fair value; growth and retention evidence support the premium.
calls.bull_case: Enterprise expansion could push fair value above $184 over time.
calls.bear_case: Forward P/E of 80 vs 60 a few months ago; less excited at these levels.

calls.thesis: Guest Mark Chaikin: Palantir bottomed out after a >50% pullback, power gauge bullish again, established uptrend; government + enterprise data processing moat, "leader in the next wave of the AI boom".
calls.base_case: Chaikin thinks PLTR makes a new high as market rises ~20% over next 9 months from midterm low.

calls.thesis: Bridget (MarketBeat host): personal impression - long-term growth story but not a slam-dunk buy-the-dip; expect volatility.
calls.note: Channel's last tracked PLTR call was guest Chaikin's BUY (Sep 29) - different speaker, not a same-voice flip.
